lock. - Fabric 1.21.4

1. Install Java 21 (https://adoptium.net) if you don't have it.
2. Run fabric-installer-1.0.1.jar (double click, or: java -jar fabric-installer-1.0.1.jar)
   -> Client tab, Minecraft 1.21.4, Loader 0.16.14 (or newer), Install.
3. Copy BOTH jars from the mods/ folder into your .minecraft/mods folder
   (mac: ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods).
4. Launch the "fabric-loader-1.21.4" profile.
5. In game press Right Shift for the menu. Left click toggles, right click opens settings.

Config: .minecraft/config/lock.json
